richest.name: Richest great power
richest.heading: Richest great power
richest.desc: Have the most gold a year of the great powers of {rules.start} when the war ends in {rules.end.season|season} {rules.end.year}.
richest.who: The great powers of {rules.start} that have no people to unite. Only the richest of them meets it.

unite.name: Unite a people
unite.heading: Unite a people
unite.desc: Proclaim {the}{title} by holding {need} of its provinces, and still hold them in {rules.end.season|season} {rules.end.year}.
unite.who: The nations of a divided people. The first to proclaim it takes its name, and the rest have lost.
unite.proclaimText: A people united. Holding {n} of its people's lands, {nation} is proclaimed.

survive.name: Survive
survive.heading: Survive
survive.desc: Still be on the map in {rules.end.season|season} {rules.end.year}.
survive.who: Every other nation. All who are still on the map meet it.
